source_data.desc:
_As patient as a fisherman, the angler worm lights a beacon in the darkness and waits for its next meal._  
**Silk Snares.** The angler worm burrows into the ceilings of caves and tunnels, where it creates snares from strong silk threads coated with sticky mucus. It then lures prey into its snares while remaining safely hidden itself, emerging only to feed. With dozens of snares, food always comes to the angler worm eventually.
source_data.name: Angler Worm
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Spider Climb", "desc": "The worm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and along its snare lines, without needing an ability check. The angler worm is never restrained by its own or other angler worms' snare lines."}, {"name": "Keen Touch", "desc": "The angler worm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on vibrations."}, {"name": "Transparent Trap", "desc": "A successful DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check must be made to spot angler worm snare lines, and the check is always made with disadvantage unless the searcher has some means of overcoming the snares' invisibility. A creature that enters a space containing angler worm snare lines must make a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the sticky snares (escape DC 14). This saving throw is made with disadvantage if the creature was unaware of the snare lines' presence."}]

en.description:
_As patient as a fisherman, the angler worm lights a beacon in the darkness and waits for its next meal._  
**Silk Snares.** The angler worm burrows into the ceilings of caves and tunnels, where it creates snares from strong silk threads coated with sticky mucus. It then lures prey into its snares while remaining safely hidden itself, emerging only to feed. With dozens of snares, food always comes to the angler worm eventually.
en.name: Angler Worm

ru.description:
Терпеливый, как рыбак, червь-рыболов зажигает маяк в темноте и ждёт своей следующей еды.

**Шёлковые силки.** Червь-рыболов зарывается в потолки пещер и туннелей, где он создаёт силки из сильных шёлковых нитей, покрытых липкой слизью. Затем он заманивает добычу в свои силки, оставаясь сам безопасно скрытым, появляясь только, чтобы питаться. С дюжинами силков еда всегда приходит к червю-рыболову в конечном счёте.
ru.name: Червь-рыболов
